title: ui: the inline grid renderer keeps its own SORT_FIELD_NAMES list instead of the spec's deriveInlineGridSortField, and nothing pins the two equal
body:
domain:spec#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzh7cM8EmUX4T2CBNHX

## What is wrong

PR #32276 (#32256) publishes `deriveInlineGridSortField(def)` from `@objectstack/spec/data`. It picks the inline grid's line-position field: the first field, in field order, whose name is in the spec's private `INLINE_GRID_SORT_FIELDS`. The lint rule `field-no-consumers` now credits that field through the helper.

The renderer does not call the helper. `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/deriveMasterDetail.ts` L55 keeps its own `SORT_FIELD_NAMES` literal (`position, sort_order, sequence, line_no, line_number, sort`), and L535 applies the same first-match rule. Nothing pins the two lists equal. If either list changes alone, lint credits one field while the grid orders by another. The contract review on PR #32276 (comment 6772543690) raised this as a follow-up.

## Ask

- Make `deriveDetail` in `deriveMasterDetail.ts` call `deriveInlineGridSortField` from `@objectstack/spec/data`, and delete the local `SORT_FIELD_NAMES`. `plugin-form` already depends on `@objectstack/spec`.
- Keep the existing behaviour: `MasterDetailForm.tsx` uses `sortField` on the authored and derived branches and in `$orderby`. Pin one child with a sort-named field and one without.

Depends on PR #32276 landing first, because the helper does not exist on `main` until then.
